### Quick Start with Docker Compose

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Quick start using docker compose to start both news push and MCP services. Requires cloning the repository and running from the docker directory.

```bash
# Clone project (Recommended)
git clone https://github.com/sansan0/TrendRadar.git
cd TrendRadar/docker
docker compose up -d

# Check running status
docker ps | grep trendradar
```

### Usage examples for Continue

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Example prompts to use with the configured MCP server.

```text
Analyze recent 7 days "Tesla" popularity trend
Generate today's trending summary report
Search "Bitcoin" related news and analyze sentiment
```

--------------------------------

### Combined Example: config.yaml and frequency_words.txt

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Combined example showing config.yaml and frequency_words.txt. The frequency_words.txt uses @N to override the global max_news_per_keyword for specific keywords.

```yaml
# config.yaml
report:
  sort_by_position_first: true   # Config order priority
  max_news_per_keyword: 10       # Global default max 10 per keyword

```

```txt
# frequency_words.txt
Tesla
Musk
@20              # Key focus, show 20 (override global)

Huawei           # Use global config, show 10

BYD
@5               # Limit to 5

```

### Install uv

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Commands to install uv on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Include the macOS/Linux command and the Windows PowerShell command as separate code blocks.

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
```

```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"
```

--------------------------------

### Build and start Docker services with docker compose

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Builds and starts Docker services. Option A builds all services, Option B only the news push service, Option C only the MCP AI analysis service.

```bash
# Option A: Build and start all services
docker compose build
docker compose up -d

# Option B: Build and start news push service only
docker compose build trendradar
docker compose up -d trendradar

# Option C: Build and start MCP AI analysis service only
docker compose build trendradar-mcp
docker compose up -d trendradar-mcp
```

--------------------------------

### Clone and run TrendRadar with uv

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Commands to clone the TrendRadar repository and start the application using uv. uv automatically installs Python and project dependencies.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sansan0/TrendRadar.git
cd TrendRadar
uv sync          # Automatically installs Python and project dependencies
uv run python -m trendradar
```

### Display Mode Example Comparison (keyword vs platform)

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Example comparison of keyword mode (group by keyword) and platform mode (group by platform) for push messages and HTML reports.

```text
# keyword mode (group by keyword)
📊 Trending Keywords Stats
🔥 [1/3] AI : 12 items
  1. [Weibo] OpenAI releases GPT-5 #1-#3 - 08:30 (5 times)
  2. [Zhihu] How to view AI replacing programmers #2 - 09:15 (3 times)

# platform mode (group by platform)
📊 Trending News Stats
🔥 [1/4] Weibo : 12 items
  1. [AI] OpenAI releases GPT-5 #1-#3 - 08:30 (5 times)
  2. [Trump] Trump announces major policy #2 - 09:15 (3 times)
```

### Global Filter Matching Example

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Matching example for the global filter. The word 'advertisement' is globally filtered, while 'technology' and 'AI' are keyword groups. The example shows that content containing 'advertisement' is rejected, while content matching 'technology' or 'AI' is accepted.

```txt
[GLOBAL_FILTER]
advertisement

[WORD_GROUPS]
technology
AI
```

### HTTP start command for Windows and Mac/Linux

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Commands to start the TrendRadar HTTP service. Used before configuring MCP clients. Replace with your actual script names.

```bash
# Windows
start-http.bat

# Mac/Linux
./start-http.sh
```

### Group Feature Configuration Example

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Example configuration for the group feature. Empty lines separate groups, each group is independently counted. Group 1 requires 'launch', group 2 requires 'fluctuation' and filters 'prediction', group 3 requires 'match'.

```txt
iPhone
Huawei
OPPO
+launch

A-shares
Shanghai Index
Shenzhen Index
+fluctuation
!prediction

World Cup
Euro Cup
Asian Cup
+match

```

### Start MCP Service Separately (Linux/Mac and Windows PowerShell)

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Start the MCP service container separately. Ensure config/ and output/ folders exist in the current directory with config files and news data before running. The service listens on 127.0.0.1:3333.

```bash
# Linux/Mac
docker run -d --name trendradar-mcp \
  -p 127.0.0.1:3333:3333 \
  -v $(pwd)/config:/app/config:ro \
  -v $(pwd)/output:/app/output:ro \
  -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai \
  wantcat/trendradar-mcp:latest
```

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
docker run -d --name trendradar-mcp `
  -p 127.0.0.1:3333:3333 `
  -v ${PWD}/config:/app/config:ro `
  -v ${PWD}/output:/app/output:ro `
  -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai `
  wantcat/trendradar-mcp:latest
```

--------------------------------

### Regex Matching Example with Config

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Matching example for the regex pattern. The configuration uses the regex /(?<![a-z])ai(?![a-z])/ and the normal keyword 'artificial intelligence'. It matches standalone 'AI' and 'ai' with non-letter boundaries, and 'artificial intelligence', but not 'ai' inside 'training' or 'maid'.

```txt
# Config
/(?<![a-z])ai(?![a-z])/
artificial intelligence
```

--------------------------------

### ntfy Topic Name Format Example

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Shows the suggested format for ntfy topic names, with good and bad examples. Topic names cannot use Chinese characters.

```text
Suggested format: trendradar-{your initials}-{random numbers}

Cannot use Chinese

✅ Good example: trendradar-zs-8492
❌ Bad example: news, alerts (too easy to guess)
```

--------------------------------

### Template Examples (JSON)

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Shows three JSON template formats: default, Discord, and custom. The template must be valid JSON. Different platforms have different message format requirements.

```json
# Default format (used when empty)
{"title": "{title}", "content": "{content}"}

# Discord format
{"content": "{content}"}

# Custom format
{"text": "{content}", "username": "TrendRadar"}
```

--------------------------------

### Display Name Configuration Example

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Example configuration for display names. The regex pattern is given the display name 'AI Related', and the normal keyword 'artificial intelligence' is also included. The display name is used in push notifications and HTML pages.

```txt
# Config
/(?<![a-zA-Z])ai(?![a-zA-Z])/ => AI Related
artificial intelligence
```

--------------------------------

### Start MCP AI Analysis Service Only with Docker Compose

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Starts only the trendradar-mcp service for AI analysis. Use this option when you need the AI analysis interface, for example with ChatGPT or Gemini.

```bash
# Start trendradar-mcp only (AI analysis interface)
docker compose pull trendradar-mcp
docker compose up -d trendradar-mcp
```

--------------------------------

### Configuration Tips: From Broad to Strict Strategy

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Configuration tips showing a strategy from broad to strict. Start with broad keywords, then add required words (+), then add filter words (!) to refine matching.

```txt
# Step 1: Start with broad keywords for testing
Artificial Intelligence
AI
ChatGPT

# Step 2: After finding mismatches, add required words
Artificial Intelligence
AI
ChatGPT
+technology

# Step 3: After finding noise, add filter words
Artificial Intelligence
AI
ChatGPT
+technology
!advertisement
!training

```

Recommended configuration splitting into precise groups to avoid over-complexity.

```txt
Huawei
OPPO
+new product

Apple
Samsung
+launch

phone

+market

```

### Avoid Over-Complexity: Not Recommended Configuration

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Not recommended configuration with too many words in one group, leading to over-complexity.

```txt
Huawei
OPPO
Apple
Samsung
vivo
OnePlus
Meizu
+phone
+launch
+sales
!fake
!repair
!second-hand

```

### Docker 环境变量配置（bash）

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README.md

通过环境变量设置排序优先级和每个关键词的最大新闻数量，对应 config.yaml 中的配置项。

```bash
SORT_BY_POSITION_FIRST=true
MAX_NEWS_PER_KEYWORD=10
```

### Start News Push Service Only with Docker Compose

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Starts only the trendradar service for scheduled crawling and news push. Use this option if you only need the push functionality.

```bash
# Start trendradar only (scheduled crawling and push)
docker compose pull trendradar
docker compose up -d trendradar
```

--------------------------------

### Enable schedule with morning_evening preset in config.yaml

Source: https://github.com/sansan0/trendradar/blob/master/README-EN.md

Configures the schedule section in config.yaml to enable the scheduling system and select the 'morning_evening' preset template. This is the recommended preset for incremental pushes throughout the day plus an evening summary.

```yaml
schedule:
  enabled: true
  preset: "morning_evening"     # Change this line
```
